title: Dented white van seen at the facility and followed
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Dented white van seen at the facility and followed, about early 1990s at Maryland, near the training facility and the Holiday Inn, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Maryland, near the training facility and the Holiday Inn

tellings.quote: it. I looked at the white band that I saw at the exit and sure enough it had that same exact uh dent.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant who says the NSA (the National Security Agency, the US government's electronic spying agency) trained him to communicate with aliens, tells of the early 1990s in Maryland. He says he noticed a white van with a distinctive dent at the exit of his training facility, and later saw a van with the exact same dent near his Holiday Inn, which told him he was being followed and watched.
